name: a_terms_page_belongs_to_its_receipt
note: The page a grouper is tempted to drop: page 2 is the back side of ticket 5512, carrying a return policy, no vendor header, and no total. It belongs to the receipt in front of it. A grouper that leaves it out returns pages [1, 3] of a 3-page scan, and validate_groups then holds the WHOLE scan with an anomaly rather than filing a receipt with a page missing. That refusal is this case's real failure mode, and it is the one thing a case file cannot state as an expectation.
